name: Minecarts of every kind
note: Empty minecarts (summoned) off rails — falling, the 0.4 (0.2 in water) speed limit, halving on the ground, 5% drag in the air, water as their last tick ended — and on rails: following the rail's line at up to 0.4 a tick, 4% drag, speeding up down slopes and slowing up them, turning through curves, stopped by blocks, braked by unpowered and boosted by powered powered rails; minecarts collide with each other's and boats' boxes and push each other by their yaw
deviations: a moving minecart picks up the boats it touches (riding is not modeled; it neither picks them up nor pushes them)
yaw from an exact arctangent (the official servers use an approximation; only the push test reads it)
chest, hopper, furnace, TNT, spawner and command block minecarts
